goals: Verify that getMeunMatcheys correctly matches various URL paths, including simple, nested, invalid, and parameterized routes, against a provided list of menu paths.
activities: Assert that getMeunMatcheys returns ['/dashboard'] when provided with a simple path '/dashboard'
Assert that getMeunMatcheys returns an empty array when provided with an invalid path '/dashboardname'
Assert that getMeunMatcheys returns ['/dashboard/name'] when provided with a secondary path '/dashboard/name'
Assert that getMeunMatcheys returns ['/userinfo/:id'] when provided with a parameter path '/userinfo/2144'
Assert that getMeunMatcheys returns ['/userinfo/:id/info'] when provided with a three-parameter path '/userinfo/2144/info'
